items.title: [Jingxian Library] Closed on 11th November 2026 for staff meeting
items.author: Lee Pui Wah
items.description:
Dear Students,
Jingxian Library will be closed on 11th November 2026 for a staff meeting.
You are welcome to Kong Chian Library (at High School) which will be opened for the day.
Thank you for your understanding.
Best regards,
HCI Libraries
